title: Uniform intrinsic cohomology profile of the canonical reductions
statement: For a scheme T and an adic coefficient datum d, pbcConstantReduction is derived extension to the actual quotient-function coefficient ring followed by exact restriction to its canonically isomorphic constant coefficient presentation. PbcUniformReductionProfile T d K means that there exist integers a,b, independent of every positive quotient level, such that each constant reduction of K is in degrees [a,b] and every cohomology sheaf is intrinsically constructible in that constant presentation. No completeness or origin condition is part of this definition.
